text: Meet AgentPay. It gives an autonomous A.I. agent its own wallet, so it can pay for the services it needs, entirely on its own.
First, the human funds the wallet once, using PayPal. You add real dollars through a familiar fiat on-ramp. This is the only step that needs your approval.

Those dollars don't stay in PayPal. A treasury bridge moves them on-chain as digital U.S. dollars, into a secure wallet that the agent controls. The wallet holds the funds and signs every payment, so the human never touches a private key.

Now the agent can spend. Every service is a pay-per-call endpoint guarded by the x4-0-2 protocol. When the agent requests data, the server answers: 4-0-2, Payment Required. The agent's wallet signs a U.S. dollar payment, settles it instantly on-chain, and the server unlocks the content.

From a single prompt, the agent checks its balance, browses the marketplace, and buys several services at once. A live Brent crude snapshot, and a momentum signal, each paid on-chain, with no further human approval.
Dollars in, through PayPal. Held and settled on-chain as U.S. dollars. Autonomous pay-per-use, through x4-0-2. That is AgentPay. The payment rail for agentic A.I.
